::: {.faq-item}
### Where does the NBA data come from?

Compiled by Slam Dunk Bets from the NBA's official game statistics: player box scores and starting lineups. Fantasy points, usage rate and rest days are computed from those box scores by the formulas in the column descriptions.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### When are in-season NBA files updated?

Rebuilt every morning by 8 AM ET. Completed seasons are final and only change if we repost a correction.
:::
